summary: This Secret History lecture is already-public Sacred Machines support for pyramids, temples, heaven-on-earth building, and capitalism as the modern replacement religion, while adding held seed pressure around common sacrifice as the shared sacred vision that lets a people build tremendous things together.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: The pyramid is not merely a tomb but a temple-like expression of religious imagination, and modern capitalism replaces spiritual heaven-on-earth building with money, numbers, computers, and process.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The public Sacred Machines page already cites this source in the Heaven On Earth section. The active mechanism is a material or staged form that lets invisible order organize public labor, not a standalone Pyramids, Gobekli Tepe, or Heaven On Earth topic.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: keep this source as the later Secret History intensification of Sacred Machines, where pyramids, temples, and modern megaprojects are judged by whether they concentrate shared imagination, common sacrifice, and a heaven-on-earth claim into public labor. Future replacement/compression could sharpen the common-sacrifice language only if the page needs a stronger diagnostic for why modern process cannot build comparable wonders.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Sacred Machines owns the source when the question is how a public form, ritual center, temple, pyramid, or megaproject bridges invisible order into collective action. Do not split standalone Heaven On Earth, Pyramids, Gobekli Tepe, Catalhoyuk, Ancient Megaprojects, or Common Sacrifice pages from this source alone.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use as comparison pressure for Civilization As Inner Order: religion answers origin, purpose, and destination; farming and settlement become acceptable because the sacred center makes hard material life meaningful; communities stay fluid, diverse, and exit-capable before hierarchy hardens.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Civilization owns the source only when the mechanism is a whole lived order: religion, food, settlement, hierarchy, exit, ritual ecology, and identity belonging to one world. Sacred Machines owns concentrated public forms; Taboo owns forbidden boundaries; Power owns later conversion into command or capital.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold as boundary pressure around temple value and modern capitalism: a sacred center becomes valuable real estate, tribute, succession conflict, factional struggle, and eventually a modern religion of money, process, and numbers. Do not append ordinary Power prose unless a future comparison asks how sacred value becomes institutional or capital power.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Power As Alchemy should receive this source only when the active mechanism is sacred imagination converting into property, institutional value, ownership, capital, or command. Sacred Machines remains the main public home for temple/pyramid/megaproject coordination.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use only in future comparison if Taboo needs a constructive ritual-balance primitive: killing animals, eating meat, and maintaining the forest script are governed by permission, thanks, reciprocity, and practices that keep the world in harmony.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Taboo owns the source only where action is governed by a sacred boundary or ritual obligation. Civilization owns the broader moral ecology, and Sacred Machines owns public forms that make invisible order inhabitable.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Keep as origin contrast only: heaven-on-earth building in this lecture names a broad sacred construction impulse, not yet the end-times role-script, ritual sequence, Antichrist, holy empire, or forecast choreography that Eschatology owns in later sources.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Do not route this source to Eschatology unless a future comparison asks how a sacred project shifts from common construction into final-order script or obedient holy empire.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold only as weak background pressure: Jiang briefly links temple succession, factions, secret societies, blood oaths, religious conflict, and sacrifice to early settled society, but this source does not provide enough organization mechanics for a Secret Society extension.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Secret Society owns hidden trust, initiation, oath, blackmail, secrecy, and coordination machinery. This source only names early factional pressure around sacred real estate; do not create a secret-society origin page from it.

new_lens_seeds.title: Common Sacrifice Builds Heaven On Earth
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A people can build tremendous public forms when they share a sacred image strongly enough that individual authorship, profit, process, and private credit become secondary to a common act of sacrifice.
new_lens_seeds.reuse_potential: This seed could later compare pyramids, temples, cathedrals, the Manhattan Project, monastic austerity, civic megaprojects, and modern capital/platform substitutes, but current public homes already cover the main pressure through Sacred Machines, Civilization As Inner Order, Power As Alchemy, and Eschatology.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Hold this as a routing seed, not a public page. It becomes public only if later sources prove a narrower mechanism beyond Sacred Machines' public-form bridge and Civilization's whole-world inner order.

new_lens_seeds.title: Sacred Center Becomes Political Real Estate
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A temple begins as a place for God on earth, then becomes the most valuable real estate because tribute, authority, succession, factions, and sacrifice gather around whoever controls the interface.
new_lens_seeds.reuse_potential: This seed may later bridge Sacred Machines, Power As Alchemy, Religion As Administrative Filter, Bureaucracy, Secret Society, and Taboo, but one lecture supplies only the origin sketch and not enough multi-source pressure for public promotion.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Do not promote as a standalone Sacred Real Estate, Temple Politics, or Secret Society origin page until compared against church office, palace-temple, bureaucratic interface, and capital-safe-house sources.

chronology_notes.note: Dated 2025-10-24, this source is a later Secret History intensification of the early-civilization sacred-machine spine already built from 2024-08-29 Gobekli Tepe, 2024-09-03 cave-painting ritual, 2024-11-26 pyramid battery, and 2024-11-28 Mesopotamian immortality sources. It adds the explicit contrast between shared sacred construction and modern capitalism/process as the replacement religion.

The source repeats the religion-before-economics and farming-as-sacrifice model from earlier civilization lectures but does not overturn that chronology. Treat it as later synthesis rather than origin evidence for Gobekli Tepe, Catalhoyuk, cave religion, or agriculture.

The lecture closes by making common sacrifice the explicit lost mentality behind tremendous shared accomplishment. This is currently seed pressure only; it may become a public mechanism if later dated sources show a repeated pattern distinct from Sacred Machines and Civilization As Inner Order.
The semantic chronology notes flag the Aachen cathedral date as likely ASR/date noise. Do not rely on that date in public chronology without a separate correction.

next_actions.action: No immediate public prose mutation is required: Sacred Machines already cites this source for the later heaven-on-earth and modern-capitalism contrast, and this PR records source-to-lens accounting only.

Do not create standalone Heaven On Earth, Common Sacrifice, Pyramid Imagination, Pyramids, Gobekli Tepe, Catalhoyuk, Temple Real Estate, Temple Politics, Farming Sucks, Religion Is Capitalism, Polynesian Navigation, or Ancient Megaproject pages from this source alone.

If downstream synthesis follows, compare common-sacrifice seed pressure against Sacred Machines' public-form bridge, Civilization's religion-makes-society anchor, Power's money-as-modern-religion and abstraction-to-command mechanisms, and Eschatology's later final-order scripts before promoting any public page.

If provenance maintenance follows, batch it by concept: exact Sacred Machines episode marks could link to existing sacred-machine anchors, but broad episode-to-lens links should avoid blurring Sacred Machines, Civilization, Taboo, Power, Eschatology, and Secret Society boundaries.
